Thank you for considering {{custom_values.business_name}} for your team. This proposal covers what we bring, how the day runs and what it costs, so you can get sign-off without another meeting.

What your team gets

• A full {{custom_values.rental_asset_name}} delivered, set up and run by our staff at your office, venue or offsite

• {{custom_values.what_is_included}}

• Nobody has to be a golfer. Closest-to-the-pin and long-drive contests keep a mixed group engaged, and the simulator runs itself while people eat and talk

• Optional: sponsor or company branding on screen, prizes for contest winners, a leaderboard for the day

How the day runs

• We arrive about {{custom_values.setup_time_required}} before your start time and are ready before the first guest walks in

• Guests rotate in small groups; a typical hour handles 12 to 16 players

• Teardown happens after your booked hours. Your space is back to normal within the hour

Investment

Corporate events start at {{custom_values.corporate_starting_price}} and are built around headcount and hours. Your itemized quote follows this proposal; additional hours, add-ons and travel are listed separately so nothing is hidden.

• {{custom_values.package_2_name}} · {{custom_values.package_2_duration}} · {{custom_values.package_2_price}}

• {{custom_values.package_3_name}} · {{custom_values.package_3_duration}} · {{custom_values.package_3_price}}

• {{custom_values.package_4_name}} · {{custom_values.package_4_duration}} · {{custom_values.package_4_price}}

What we need from you

• Space of {{custom_values.space_requirement_footprint}} with {{custom_values.space_requirement_height}} overhead, and {{custom_values.power_requirement}} nearby

• A date. {{custom_values.deposit_percent}} deposit holds it; the balance is due {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before

• Any venue paperwork (COI, access, parking) at least 7 days out. We handle the rest

Next step

Reply to this email or call {{custom_values.business_phone}} with your preferred date and rough headcount. We will check the calendar the same day and send the quote.
